title: Python tunnel_auth: all 12 tests in test_tunnel_auth{,_vectors}.py red on clean HEAD (valid case -> MALFORMED)
description: Discovered while working tpbj (spec fix, unrelated markdown-only change). On clean HEAD of branch beads-worker-7 @ 73694c0b92, python3 -m pytest tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth.py tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py gives 12 failed / 8 passed -- the ENTIRE test surface of both files: signature validation, replay, LRU, root-change, egress, data-plane, concurrency, property round-trip, and both vector-driven production-path tests. Representative failure: test_post_cases_drive_python_production_path case valid_root_egress -> AuthorizationResult(allowed=False, denial=TunnelDenial.MALFORMED) where allowed=True expected; vector cose_sign1_hex is the wrapped form 8447a1013a00010000... and the Python decoder (src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py:233-242) requires bstr-wrapped + canonical map. Total-wipe pattern points at a common fixture/helper or recent production-path change, not 12 independent bugs. Suspect a recent tunnel-auth commit on this branch line -- bisect python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py and tests/gateway/ helpers. Repro: cd python && python3 -m pytest tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth.py tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py -q.
close_reason: Resolved by project-LICHEN-worker6-anyv dependency fix. The 12 red tests (test_tunnel_auth{,_vectors}.py) were not a production-path bug: the venv lacked pytest-asyncio/hypothesis/jsonschema because [dependency-groups] dev declared only bare pytest while the canonical set lived in [project.optional-dependencies] dev. uv installed the former. After adding pytest-asyncio/pytest-timeout/pytest-cov/httpx/hypothesis/jsonschema to dependency-groups.dev + uv sync, all 20 tunnel_auth tests pass (uv run pytest tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth{,_vectors}.py: 20 passed).
